parsed_content.name: Swiggy Ornge HDFC Bank Credit Card

fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹1.5 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.5% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.5₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card (minimum ₹500, if applicable).
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge fee of 1% applies on rental transactions made using the credit card
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Additional ₹100 is charged if Minimum Amount Due remains unpaid for two consecutive cycles, continuing until cleared

rewards.redemption_options: This is a cashback card, and the earned cashback is adjusted directly in your monthly statement.
rewards.exclusions: Fuel, Rent, Jewellery, Government payments, Gaming, Education, Wallets, Gift Cards, EMI transactions, SmartPay, SmartBuy portal and cash advances
rewards.exclusion_spends: Cash Advances, Balance Transfer, ATM Cash Withdrawals

• 5% cashback on Swiggy app spends (Food Delivery, Instamart, Dineout)
• Cashback capped at ₹1,500 per billing cycle for Swiggy spends
• 5% cashback on select online merchants and categories like apparel, electronics, travel, pharmacies, entertainment and discount stores
• 1% cashback on other eligible spends
• 1% cashback capped at ₹1,000 per billing cycle
• Complimentary Swiggy One membership for 12 months on card activation

• Cleartrip offer 5% cashback on eligible online spends
• Additional 6% instant discount on flight bookings via Cleartrip
• Up to 19% instant discount on hotel bookings via Cleartrip
